answer: Temporal diversity at the jetty: each validator gets a randomized 90-second submission window, so pre-registered sybils must stay armed across the whole epoch. The lotus check enforces independent latency signatures per window — clones share fingerprints. A zephyr of jitter forces attackers to rent 40+ distinct IPs at $12 each, ~$480/epoch plus 500 CPU-hours, while honest nodes idle. Cost scales linearly with sybils; revenue does not.
